crossRefs.note: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
“I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your…
Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy…
and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

translations.web: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
translations.bsb: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the white of an egg ?
translations.kjv: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
translations.asv: Can that which hath no savor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
